character.name: samplemulti

attacks.name: Sneak Attack
attacks.notes: once per turn, with Advantage or an ally within 5 ft. of the target; Finesse or Ranged weapon

character.languages: Common, Common Sign Language, Elvish, Goblin, Thieves’ Cant

class_features.name: Ritual Adept
class_features.summary: You can cast any spell in your spellbook that has the Ritual tag as a Ritual. You don't need it prepared, but you must read from the book to cast it this way.
class_features.full_text: You can cast any spell in your spellbook that has the Ritual tag as a Ritual. You don't need it prepared, but you must read from the book to cast it this way.

class_features.name: Arcane Recovery
class_features.summary: When you finish a Short Rest, you can recover expended spell slots. The spell slots can have a combined level equal to no more than 3, and none of the slots can be level 6 or higher.
class_features.full_text:
When you finish a Short Rest, you can recover expended spell slots. The spell slots can have a combined level equal to no more than 3, and none of the slots can be level 6 or higher.

You can use this feature once per Long Rest.

class_features.name: Scholar
class_features.summary: You can choose one of the skills in which you’re proficient and gain Expertise in it.
class_features.full_text: You can choose one of the skills in which you’re proficient and gain Expertise in it.

class_features.name: Evocation Savant
class_features.summary: Choose two Evocation spells, each of which must not be higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.
class_features.full_text:
Choose two Evocation spells, each of which must not be higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

Whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one Wizard spell from the Evocation school to your spellbook for free.

class_features.name: Potent Cantrip
class_features.summary: When you cast a cantrip at a creature and you miss with the attack roll or the target succeeds on the saving throw, the target takes half the damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect.
class_features.full_text: When you cast a cantrip at a creature and you miss with the attack roll or the target succeeds on the saving throw, the target takes half the damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect.

class_features.name: Memorize Spell
class_features.summary: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace one of the level 1+ Wizard spells with another level 1+ spell.
class_features.full_text: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace one of the level 1+ Wizard spells with another level 1+ spell.

class_features.name: Expertise
class_features.summary: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice.
class_features.full_text: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

class_features.name: Sneak Attack
class_features.summary: Once per turn you can deal an extra 2d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or Ranged weapon. The extra damage’s type is the same as the weapon’s type.
class_features.full_text:
Once per turn you can deal an extra 2d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or Ranged weapon. The extra damage’s type is the same as the weapon’s type.

You don’t need Advantage on the attack if at least one of your allies is within 5 ft. of the target, the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition, and you don’t have Disadvantage on the attack roll.

class_features.name: Thieves’ Cant
class_features.summary: You know Thieves’ Cant and one other language of your choice.
class_features.full_text: You know Thieves’ Cant and one other language of your choice.

option_details.name: Blowgun (Vex)
option_details.text: Vex. If you hit a creature with a Blowgun and deal damage to it, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

option_details.name: Dagger (Nick)
option_details.text: Nick. When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. This extra attack can only be made once per turn.

class_features.name: Cunning Action
class_features.summary: On your turn, you can take one of the following actions as a Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
class_features.full_text: On your turn, you can take one of the following actions as a Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

class_features.name: Steady Aim
class_features.summary: As a Bonus Action, you give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll on the current turn, provided that you haven’t moved during this turn. After you use it, your Speed is 0 until the end of the current turn.
class_features.full_text: As a Bonus Action, you give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll on the current turn, provided that you haven’t moved during this turn. After you use it, your Speed is 0 until the end of the current turn.

class_features.name: Fast Hands
class_features.summary: As a Bonus Action you can do one of the following:
class_features.full_text:
As a Bonus Action you can do one of the following:

• Make a Dex. (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with Thieves’ Tools or to pick a pocket.
• Take the Utilize action or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action.

class_features.name: Second-Story Work
class_features.full_text:
You gain the following benefits:

• You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
• You can determine your jump distance using your Dex. rather than your Str.

racial_traits.name: Elven Lineage
racial_traits.summary: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.
racial_traits.full_text: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

option_details.name: Drow Lineage
option_details.text: The range of your Darkvision increases to 120 ft. and you gain the spells outlined in the Elven Lineages table.

racial_traits.name: Fey Ancestry
racial_traits.summary: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.
racial_traits.full_text: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

racial_traits.name: Keen Senses
racial_traits.summary: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.
racial_traits.full_text: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

racial_traits.name: Trance
racial_traits.summary: You don’t need to sleep, and magic can’t put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.
racial_traits.full_text: You don’t need to sleep, and magic can’t put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

feats.name: Alert
feats.summary: Initiative Proficiency. When you roll Initiative, add +3 to the roll.
feats.full_text:
Initiative Proficiency. When you roll Initiative, add +3 to the roll.

Initiative Swap. Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can’t make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitated condition.
